task.description: Produce a code design artefact for WF-02 run WF02-prm02-05-20260816 covering requirements PRM-02 (Conflict pre-flight rejection), PRM-03 (Plan digest binds approval to a diff), PRM-04 (Promotion review state machine), PRM-05 (Non-skippable human approval gate). All four are MUST-priority, stage 16, backend requirements in the promotion pipeline (workflow PW-01), building on the already-released PRM-01 (promotion plan and diff report in src/api/routes/promotions.zig) and PRM-06..09. Read docs/requirements.yaml for the full acceptance criteria of PRM-02..05, read src/design/prm01-promotion-plan-diff.md (if present) for the PRM-01 design to extend, and follow the WF-02 Step 1 procedure (fn:load-requirements, fn:read-backend-conventions). For each requirement: map every acceptance criterion to a concrete design element (function/component/schema), define public signatures with inputs/outputs/errors, describe the new promotion_reviews table (columns, CHECK constraint over the six status values, the partial unique index promotion_reviews_plan_digest_active_uniq over (tenant_id, plan_digest) WHERE status IN ('pending_review','approved')), the plan_digest canonical JSON serialisation (sorted keys, no insignificant whitespace, entry shape {type,id,changes}), the conflict pre-flight ordering guarantee (before digest and before review row), and the no-bypass approval gate with the GET /api/v1/promotions/{id}/context contract. Include a data-flow/sequence diagram for the multi-step promotion flow and an error taxonomy. Do NOT write implementation code (no Zig/SQL/TS code blocks).
acceptance_criteria: Every acceptance criterion of PRM-02..05 maps to a concrete design element
promotion_reviews schema fully specified (columns, CHECK, partial unique index)
Conflict pre-flight ordering and no-bypass approval gate designed
Public function signatures fully specified with errors
No implementation code in the design artefact

result.summary: Design artefact for PRM-02..05 (promotion approval pipeline) written to src/design/prm02-05-promotion-approval-pipeline.md; every AC mapped, schema/digest/ordering/gate specified, error taxonomy present, lint_design_artefact.py clean.
